Declaration of general A.A.Vlasov distributed by German Information Service.

According to received information since 28.II.44 in
Shanghai is distributed by post and from hand to hand declara-
tion of general .A.Vlasov head of "Committee of liberation of
Peoples of Russia" published by local German Information Servic
The above declaration include aims and basis principle of
Movement of liberation of Russia" which was already published
by local newspapers and announced by German Radio Propaganda
through XGRM station

General Andrey Andreevich VLASOV ex commander of the
2nd Soviet Army was captured by the German Army in 1942 during
the battle near Moscow and for about two years headed anti Sovi
et movements in Germany among Russian prisoners of war, evacuat
ed Russian population, Russian workers and population of region
of USSR occupied by German Army.

According to information from German circles German
Embassy in Tokio is conducting at present negotiation with
Japanese Government regarding recognition de facto of Represent-
ative of General Vlasov in Shanghai, permission of publishing
of pro Vlasov's newspaper and open propaganda.
（批：FILE）

White Russian anti communist circles until present are
quite reserved towards pro Vlasov propaganda conducted by local
German propaganda organs. It is remembered, that after first news
regarding Vlasov over one years ago it does not appear any fur-
ther information regarding him. General G.M.Semenoff who sent
to general Vlasov a telegramme recognising as a White Russian
leader did not receive any reply. In case of the further develop-
ment of general Vlasov's movement when more information will
be received and especially if representative of general Vlasov
will be appointed part of local White Russian undoubtedly will
support this movement.

Vlasov's movements and telegrams of German agencies regarding

日期 1944年12月15日）
德国新闻处散发的弗拉索夫将军宣言。

据收到的情报，自1944年2月28日以来，在上海通过邮政及手递手方式散发由当地德国新闻处出版的“俄罗斯人民解放委员会”主席A.弗拉索夫将军的宣言。
上述宣言包括“俄罗斯解放运动”的目标和基本原则，该宣言已由当地报纸刊登，并由德国广播电台通过XGRM电台进行广播宣传。

安德烈·安德烈耶维奇·弗拉索夫将军曾任苏联第二集团军司令，于1942年在莫斯科附近的战斗中被德军俘虏，并在随后约两年时间内，在德国领导战俘中的反苏运动，对象包括被疏散的俄罗斯民众、俄罗斯工人以及被德军占领的苏联地区的人口。

据德国方面消息，日本东京的德国大使馆目前正与日本政府就以下事项进行谈判：事实上承认弗拉索夫将军在上海的代表，允许出版亲弗拉索夫的报纸，以及开展公开宣传。
（批注：归档）

白俄反共圈子迄今为止对当地德国宣传机构进行的亲弗拉索夫宣传持相当保留的态度。值得注意的是，在一年多前首次出现关于弗拉索夫的消息后，便再无关于他的进一步信息。曾向弗拉索夫将军发送电报、承认其为白俄领袖的G.M.谢苗诺夫将军未收到任何回复。如果弗拉索夫将军的运动进一步发展，获得更多情报，特别是如果任命了弗拉索夫将军的代表，当地部分白俄人士无疑将支持这一运动。

Soviets and alleged conspiracy of Marshal Timoshenko in Kiev

it is rumoured in local Soviet circles, that compulsory resignation of Marshal K. Voroshiloff from Supreme Military Council is connected with Vlasov's movement. It is said, that Marshal Voroshiloff commander of USSR Reserve Army was accused in slackness in connection with pro general Vlasov's secret cells discovered by N.K.V.D/ Government Political Police/ in above army. Some of general Vlasov's agent were sent to USSR under disguise of escaped prisoners and served in the ranks of the Reserve Army.

It is also noted, that Marshal Voroshiloff was on friendly terms with the late Marshal Tukhachevsky who was executed for conspiracy against Stalin. Marshal Voroshiloff participated in this conspiracy, but in the last moment betrayed Tukhachevsky and confessed to Stalin.

苏维埃的动荡、游击队活动，以及所谓基辅的季莫申科元帅阴谋的电报，

当地苏联圈子中流传着一种说法，即K.伏罗希洛夫元帅从最高军事委员会强制辞职与弗拉索夫运动有关。据说，担任苏联预备役部队指挥官的伏罗希洛夫元帅被指控懈怠，原因是内务人民委员部（政府政治警察）在该军队中发现了亲弗拉索夫将军的秘密小组。弗拉索夫将军的一些特工伪装成逃犯被派往苏联，并在预备役部队中服役。

另有人指出，伏罗希洛夫元帅与已故的图哈切夫斯基元帅关系友好，后者因策划反对斯大林的阴谋而被处决。伏罗希洛夫元帅参与了该阴谋，但在最后时刻背叛了图哈切夫斯基并向斯大林坦白。

随函附上俄文版《A.A.弗拉索夫将军宣言》副本一份。

AIMS AND GENERAL PRINIPLE OF
" COMMITTEE OF LIBERATION OF PEOPLES OF RUSSIA "

A.- Overthrow of Stalin's tyrany,liberation of peoples of our
Motherland from bolshevik regim and restoration of the right
obtained during February Revolution of 1917.

B.- Ending of the war and conclusion of honorary peace with
Germany.

V.- Creation of a new free state without bolsheviks and exploi-
tators.
This peoples government will be founded on the following
basic principles

I.- Equal rights to all peoples of our Motherland,full esteem
being paid to their rights of national development,selfdeter
-mination and independence.

2.- Creation of the state system based on principles of nati-
onal equalities,similarity of social standard and freedom
of national development.

3.- Maintainance of the peace and reestablishment of friendly
relations with all allied nations.

4.- Large government measures in order to strenghten family
life and marriage.

5.- Abolishing of enforced labour.

6.- Liquidation of kolkhose/collective farms/ and handing over
the earth to farmers for private exploitation,abolishing of
forced requisitions and supplies of any kind.

7.- Reinstatment of private property obtained by personal
labour,rrestablishment of commerce and creation of favoura-
ble condition for private initiative in economical life of
the state.

8.- Creation of large possibility for Scientist and all int-
electual workers for the work for the people.

9.- Social justice and protection of workers from any kind of
exploitation indiscriminate of their ██████ origin or former
profession.

10.- Right of free education,holidays leaves.old age pension
██████ indiscriminate of their origin or former profession

11.- Abolishing of system of terror and compulsory settling
/excile/,restoration of freedom of religion,freedom of con-
science,freedom of publication,freedom of speeches,freedom
of meetings ,inviolability of person,premises and property.

12.- Liberation of all political prisoners and return to their
place of residence of all political prisoners imprisoned in
gaols and concentration camps.No vengeance to follower of
stalin-bolshevism irrespective whether they struggled being
forced or voluntarily.

13.- Reestablishing of towns villages destroyed during the war
by the state.

A.A.弗拉索夫将军俄文宣言副本译文。

“俄罗斯人民解放委员会”的目标和一般原则

A.- 推翻斯大林的暴政，将我国人民从布尔什维克政权下解放出来，恢复1917年二月革命期间获得的权利。

B.- 结束战争，并与德国缔结光荣的和平。

V.- 建立一个没有布尔什维克和剥削者的新的自由国家。
这个人民政府将建立在以下基本原则之上：

I.- 我国所有民族权利平等，充分尊重其民族发展、自决和独立的权利。

2.- 建立基于民族平等、社会标准相似性和民族发展自由原则的国家制度。

3.- 维护和平，并与所有盟国重建友好关系。

4.- 采取大规模政府措施以加强家庭生活和婚姻。

5.- 废除强迫劳动。

6.- 取消集体农庄，将土地交给农民私人经营，废除任何形式的强制征用和供应。

7.- 恢复通过个人劳动获得的私有财产，重建商业，并为国家经济生活中的私人倡议创造有利条件。

8.- 为科学家和所有知识分子提供为人民工作的广阔机会。

9.- 社会正义，保护工人免受任何形式的剥削，不论其 ██████ 出身或先前职业。

10.- 免费教育、休假、养老金的权利，██████ 不论其出身或先前职业

11.- 废除恐怖制度和强制定居（流放），恢复宗教自由、良心自由、出版自由、言论自由、集会自由，人身、住所和财产不可侵犯。

12.- 释放所有政治犯，并将关押在监狱和集中营中的所有政治犯遣返回其居住地。不报复斯大林-布尔什维主义的追随者，无论他们是被迫还是自愿斗争。

13.- 由国家重建在战争期间被摧毁的城镇和村庄。
